review_comments:
@koic 

I think there is an error here.
```ruby
hsh = { key: 'value' }
hsh&.dig(:key) # => 'value'
hsh[:key] # => 'value'

hsh = nil
hsh&.dig(:key) # => nil
hsh[:key] # => NoMethodError (undefined method `[]' for nil:NilClass)
```

I believe it should be the following:
```ruby
expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
  { key: 'value' }&.fetch(:key, nil)
RUBY
```
Sure, I've opened #12519 to revert this change.
